<!doctype html><html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#f5ead1"><meta name="description" content="言葉を集め、世界を巡り、異論を覆せ。探索型Web謎『メイクセンス』。"><title>メイクセンス | MAKE SENSE</title><style>
@charset "UTF-8";
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#0b101c;--bg2:#111827;--panel:#161e2e;--panel-soft:#1c273b;--line:#303a4d;--text:#f6f4ee;--muted:#a4afc0;--faint:#79869b;--cream:#f7f2e9;--ink:#151b27;--accent:#d7f37f;--accent-ink:#152217;--win:#b9efb8;--draw:#f1d78e;--lose:#f6ada6;--a:#a2bcff;--b:#9ee4bf;--c:#f6cb86;--d:#cfabf4;--radius:24px;--font:'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic','Meiryo',system-ui,sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{min-height:100vh;margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:disabled{opacity:.43;cursor:not-allowed}a{color:inherit}.ambient{position:fixed;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;filter:blur(2px);border-radius:50%;opacity:.7}.ambient--left{width:750px;height:750px;top:-380px;left:-270px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#26395669,transparent var(--font);letter-spacing:.2em;color:#aebad0}.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.header-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:11px 16px;border:1px solid 5px;border-radius:16px;background:#2b374a;color:var(--cream);font:700 11px Arial}#app{flex:1;min-height:580px}.site-footer{margin-top:28px;display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:23px 0 .button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:13px;padding:15px 22px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s,background .18s;min-height:49px}.button:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.button--primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);box-shadow:0 7px 30px #c9ee701e}.button--primary:hover{background:#e4ffa0}.button--primary:disabled{background:#5d6857;color:#202820;box-shadow:none;transform:none}.button--subtle{background:#202a3c;border-color:#354157;color:var(--text)}.button--subtle:hover{border-color:#9eabba;background:#29364b}.button--large{min-width:220px;padding:17px 24px;font-size:14px;min-height:58px}.button--large>span:last-child{font-size:19px}.button--small{padding:9px 13px;min-height:34px;font-size:11px;border-radius:8px}.micro-label{font:800 10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#93a3b9}.mobile-only{display:none}
/* The four mascots are original CSS artwork; no external image assets are required. */
.avatar{--face:#d0d8f8;--body:#405990;--glow:#6d91ff;--inkface:#24344e;position:relative;display:block;width:155px;height:150px;isolation:isolate}.avatar__halo{position:absolute;left:16px;top:7px;width:125px;height:125px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--glow),transparent 73%);opacity:.35;filter:blur(8px);z-index:-1}.avatar__body{position:absolute;left:28px;right:28px;bottom:0;height:67px;border-radius:58px 58px 16px 16px;background:var(--body);border:2px solid #ffffff20;box-shadow:inset -11px -8px 0 #00000022}.avatar__head{position:absolute;left:36px;top:20px;width:83px;height:88px;border-radius:36px 39px 41px 39px;background:var(--face);border:2px solid #00000025}.avatar__eye{position:absolute;top:36px;width:7px;height:10px;background:var(--inkface);border-radius:4px}.avatar__eye--l{left:24px}.avatar__eye--r{right:23px}.avatar__smile{position:absolute;width:14px;height:8px;left:35px;top:48px;border-bottom:2.5px solid var(--inkface);border-radius:0 0 12px 12px}.avatar__sigil{position:absolute;bottom:15px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:23px;font-weight:900;color:#eaf4ff}.avatar--a{--face:#b9c9ff;--body:#405c9c;--glow:#7b9dff;--inkface:#263658}.avatar--a .avatar__head:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-10px;top:-17px;width:98px;height:28px;background:#334c80;border:1px solid #a1bdfb55;border-radius:47px 47px 14px 14px;transform:rotate(-6deg)}.avatar--a .avatar__head:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:21px;height:21px;top:31px;right:13px;border:2px solid #456299;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:5px 4px 0 -4px #456299}.avatar--b{--face:#bdf0d1;--body:#387e69;--glow:#70d5a7;--inkface:#215247}.avatar--b .avatar__head{border-radius:43% 43% 47% 47%}.avatar--b .avatar__head:before,.avatar--b .avatar__head:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:28px;height:38px;top:-15px;background:#79c7a4;border:2px solid #ffffff2c;border-radius:7px 29px 4px 6px}.avatar--b .avatar__head:before{left:1px;transform:rotate(-20deg)}.avatar--b .avatar__head:after{right:1px;transform:rotate(20deg) scaleX(-1)}.avatar--c{--face:#f6dcad;--body:#a16c3b;--glow:#eab56d;--inkface:#76502b}.avatar--c .avatar__head{border-radius:19px;transform:rotate(-5deg)}.avatar--c .avatar__head:before{content:'ＡＢ';position:absolute;font:900 13px Arial;color:#a47536;top:-20px;left:25px;letter-spacing:-.1em}.avatar--d{--face:#dfc6f2;--body:#745198;--glow:#bf8fe4;--inkface:#59436a}.avatar--d .avatar__head{border-radius:52% 42% 54% 47%;transform:rotate(8deg)}.avatar--d .avatar__head:before{content:'✦';position:absolute;right:-19px;top:-14px;font-size:30px;color:#ddbcf4}.avatar--d .avatar__head:after{content:'✧';position:absolute;left:-21px;bottom:0;font-size:23px;color:#dcadf6}
/* Home */
.intro{padding:54px 0 0;max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto}.intro__eyebrow{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font:800 11px Arial;letter-spacing:.27em;color:var(--accent)}.pulse-dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 14px var(--accent)}.intro__title{margin:22px 0 0;font:900 0 0;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.46em;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}.intro__lead{font-size:clamp(23px,3.4vw,34px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.45;letter-spacing:.025em;margin:32px 0 solid #ffffff1c;border-radius:20px;padding:14px 9px 19px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#223252c4,#17203388)}.cast-card--b{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#233d38bb,#162b2ba0)}.cast-card--c{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#463a2db8,#2b2924a0)}.cast-card--d{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#372e49c7,#29243aad)}.cast-card .avatar{transform:scale(.82);height:130px;transform-origin:center top}.cast-card__code{font:900 9px Arial;letter-spacing:.25em;color:#bdcde2;margin:5px 0 9px}.cast-card h3{margin:0;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.07em}.cast-card p{font-size:11px;color:#ccd7dd;margin:7px 0 11px}.cast-card>span:last-child{margin-top:auto;color:#99a6b5;font-size:10px}.intro__bottom{text-align:center;color:#8799ab;margin:28px 0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em}
/* Battle */
.game-view{padding:31px 0 0;--genre:var(--a)}.game-view--b{--genre:var(--b)}.game-view--c{--genre:var(--c)}.game-view--d{--genre:var(--d)}.game-topline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 24px}.breadcrumb{font:900 11px Arial;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#b7c4d7}.breadcrumb span{padding:0 9px;color:#6b7890}.status-figures{display:inline-flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font:900 19px Arial;letter-spacing:-.03em}.status-figures>span{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px}.status-figures small{font:700 11px var(--font);color:#9faebe}.status-figures i{height:16px;width:1px;background:#506078;transform:rotate(18deg)}.stage-track{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin-bottom:18px}.stage-step{border:1px solid #3d4a5e;background:#182232;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#75859b}.stage-step__number{height:25px;width:25px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:7px;font:800 11px Arial}.stage-step__name{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}.stage-step--current{border-color:var(--genre);color:var(--genre);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--genre) 9%,#182232)}.stage-step--done{border-color:#4b745a;color:#ade4b6;background:#1a2d29}.battle-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(290px,.88fr) minmax(380px,1.12fr);gap:17px;min-height:560px}.enemy-panel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;min-height:560px;padding:24px;border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid #ffffff23;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 31%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--genre) 18%,transparent),transparent 48%),linear-gradient(155deg,#24334a,#151e2d 75%)}.enemy-panel:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:360px;height:360px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffffff12;top:58px;pointer-events:none}.enemy-panel:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:430px;height:430px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffffff0b;top:23px;pointer-events:none}.enemy-panel__mark{position:relative;z-index:1;align-self:flex-start;font:800 10px Arial;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#a7b3c5}.enemy-panel__mark b{background:var(--genre);color:#111927;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;margin-left:6px}.enemy-panel .avatar{transform:scale(1.5);transform-origin:center center;margin:90px 0 55px;z-index:1}.enemy-panel__role{z-index:1;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:var(--genre);letter-spacing:.1em;margin:0 0 10px}.enemy-panel h1{z-index:1;font-size:35px;margin:0;letter-spacing:.09em}.enemy-panel__line{z-index:1;font-size:12px;color:#c7d2df;margin:17px 0 24px}.enemy-panel__footer{z-index:1;margin:auto 0 0;border-top:1px 6px}.challenge-panel__prompt{margin:54px 0 23px;color:#c5d0dc;font-size:14px}.challenge-panel__prompt span{color:var(--accent);font-weight:900}.enemy-word{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:26px 0 45px}.enemy-word span{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,55px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.05em;text-shadow:0 1px 0 #ffffff25}.choice-list{display:grid;gap:10px}.choice{width:100%;padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid 0 0}
/* Outcome */
.outcome-view{min-height:600px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:54px 18px 40px}.outcome-view__top{font:900 10px Arial;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#99abc3}.outcome-view__seal{display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:50px;width:100px;height:100px;border:1px solid #b9efb888;background:#b9efb816;border-radius:50%;color:var(--win);margin:25px 0 12px}.outcome-view--draw .outcome-view__seal{border-color:#f1d78e88;background:#f1d78e18;color:var(--draw)}.outcome-view--lose .outcome-view__seal{border-color:#f6ada688;background:#f6ada618;color:var(--lose)}.outcome-view__status{font:900 13px Arial;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--win)}.outcome-view--draw .outcome-view__status{color:var(--draw)}.outcome-view--lose .outcome-view__status{color:var(--lose)}.outcome-view h1{font-size:clamp(26px,5vw,45px);margin:10px 0 7px;letter-spacing:.025em}.outcome-view__desc{font-size:13px;color:#a9b7c7;line-height:1.8;margin:0}.outcome-compare{display:flex;gap:35px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:34px 0 30px;border:1px solid #ffffff2a;border-radius:18px;padding:20px 37px;background:#172131}.outcome-compare>div{min-width:125px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.outcome-compare small{font-size:10px;color:#a5b5ca}.outcome-compare strong{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.15em}.outcome-compare__versus{font:900 11px Arial;color:#6c7d93}.outcome-view__actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}.outcome-view__foot{margin:26px 0 0;color:#b5c2d1}
/* Final */
.boss-view{padding:25px 0 48px;max-width:920px;margin:0 auto}.boss-view__mark{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font:800 10px Arial;letter-spacing:.21em;color:#c5b0e1}.boss-view__orb{height:145px;width:145px;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:21px auto span{font-size:38px;font-weight:900;color:#f4e8fb}.boss-view__center{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center}.boss-view__center>.micro-label{color:#c7a2ef;margin:19px 0 0}.boss-view h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,42px);margin:9px 0 8px}.boss-view__center>p{font-size:12px;color:#bcc5d7;line-height:1.9;margin:2px 0 14px}.boss-word-label{margin:8px 0 10px;font:800 10px Arial;letter-spacing:.19em;color:#d0b4eb}.boss-slots{display:flex;gap:11px}.boss-slot{height:62px;width:62px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#172033;border:1px solid #644d7b;border-radius:12px;font-size:31px;color:#687387;font-weight:900}.boss-slot--filled{background:#322743;border-color:#b28bda;color:#f5eafd}.boss-controls{display:flex;gap:10px;margin:12px 0 16px}.kana-board{width:min(560px,100%);display:grid;gap:5px;border-radius:20px;padding:12px;background:#141c2a;border:1px solid #ffffff1b}.kana-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.kana-row__label{align-self:center;font-size:10px;color:#8493a9;text-align:center}.kana-button,.kana-blank{height:37px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #42445d;border-radius:7px;font-weight:800;font-size:17px}.kana-button{background:#283047;color:#f0e6fc;transition:.14s}.kana-button:not(:disabled):hover{border-color:#d3a7ff;background:#413652;transform:translateY(-1px)}.kana-blank{opacity:.25;border-color:#333b4d;background:#1b2432}.boss-submit{margin:15px 0 0;width:min(560px,100%)}.boss-view .boss-view__hint{font-size:10px;color:#93a2b7;margin:13px 0 0}
/* Clear */
.clear-view{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:52px 12px 30px;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}.clear-view__top{font:900 10px Arial;letter-spacing:.27em;color:var(--accent)}.clear-view__spark{display:grid;place-items:center;width:100px;height:100px;margin:30px 0;background:#d7f37f16;border:1px solid #d7f37f55;color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;font-size:63px;box-shadow:0 0 80px #d7f37f1b}.clear-view__overline{font:900 13px Arial;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--accent)}.clear-view h1{margin:15px 0 12px;font-size:clamp(38px,6vw,68px);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.4}.clear-view__sub{font-size:13px;color:#abbacb}.clear-view__metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px;width:min(520px,100%);margin:26px 0 17px}.clear-view__metrics>div{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;padding:21px 12px;border:1px solid #ffffff2b;border-radius:17px;background:#1a2635}.clear-view__metrics strong{font:900 41px Arial;letter-spacing:-.06em}.clear-view__metrics strong small{font:800 14px var(--font);letter-spacing:0;margin-left:4px}.clear-view__metrics span{font:800 9px Arial;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#91a1b4}.clear-view__stats{display:flex;gap:20px;font:800 11px Arial;color:#b5c4d4}.clear-view__actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:32px}.clear-view__spoiler{color:#8190a5;font-size:10px;margin-top:16px}.clear-view__retry{margin-top:39px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #8597ad;background:none;color:#9fb2c9;font-size:12px;padding:0 2px 6px}.clear-view__retry:hover{color:var(--cream)}

/* Timed final challenge and optional fifth-round hints. */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.word-score{font-size:.55em;color:#d8e78e;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:middle;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:0}
.enemy-word .word-score{align-self:center;display:inline-block;margin:0 0 0 10px}
.log-entry__words .word-score{font-size:.76em;color:#d8e78e}
.outcome-compare .word-score{font-size:.58em;color:#d8e78e}
.header-button--hint{white-space:nowrap;border-color:#758553;color:#dfedaa;font-size:11px;font-weight:850}
.header-button--hint[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#d6f485;background:#344129;color:#e8ffb7}
.boss-clock{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;border:1px solid #775a96;border-radius:14px;background:#251f37;padding:10px 24px;margin:10px 0 14px;width:min(390px,100%)}
.boss-clock small{font-size:11px;color:#cbb4df}.boss-clock strong{font:900 31px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#e9d4ff;min-width:116px}
.boss-clock--result{width:min(400px,100%);margin:-10px auto 24px}
.clock--urgent{color:#ff8e9b!important;animation:clockPulse .7s infinite alternate}
@keyframes clockPulse{from{opacity:1}to{opacity:.64}}
.log-clock{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:#322844;border:1px solid #8e72a5;border-radius:12px;padding:13px;margin:10px 0 18px;color:#e8d5ff;font-size:11px;font-weight:850}
.log-clock strong{font:900 23px Arial;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hint-view{min-height:65vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:35px 10px}
.hint-view__eyebrow{font:800 11px Arial;letter-spacing:.2em;color:#d5eda3}.hint-view__icon{font-size:70px;color:#d5eda3;margin:18px}.hint-view h1{font-size:clamp(27px,6vw,43px);margin:0 0 16px}.hint-view p{font-size:13px;color:#b8c7d6;line-height:2}.hint-view__actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:22px 0 0}.hint-view__note{font-size:11px!important;color:#849bb0!important}
@media(max-width:680px){.header-button--hint{font-size:10px;padding:8px}.boss-clock strong{font-size:27px}.hint-view__actions{width:100%}.hint-view__actions .button{width:100%}.log-clock{flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.enemy-word .word-score{font-size:17px}}
.boss-scoreline{text-align:center;margin:-2px 0 12px;font-weight:800;color:#deefaf}.boss-scoreline .word-score{font-size:1em}

/* MAKE SENSE: cozy-neighborhood pixel RPG skin. Logic and save data remain unchanged. */
:root{color-scheme:light;--bg:#f5ead1;--bg2:#e7d5b3;--panel:#fff7e6;--panel-soft:#fff3da;--line:#bca78b;--text:#423d3a;--muted:#736a62;--faint:#978b7d;--cream:#fff7e8;--ink:#312c30;--accent:#90a76a;--accent-ink:#233b31;--win:#658c66;--draw:#b98a3b;--lose:#ae6266;--radius:12px;--font:'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic','Meiryo',system-ui,sans-serif}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 0,#fff9ed,transparent 35%),#f2e6cd;color:var(--text)}body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.27;background-image:radial-gradient(#9e84632c 0.65px,transparent 0.65px);background-size:6px 6px;z-index:-1} .ambient{display:none!important}
.site-shell{max-width:1070px}.site-header{min-height:76px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:3px double #baa488}.brand,.site-footer{color:#50443b}.brand__symbol{background:#8d9b6b!important;border:2px solid #657f64;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #baaa8b}.brand__word{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em}.brand__word>span{color:#9b725c!important}.brand__word small{color:#8b785f!important}.header-button{color:#51453d;border:2px solid #c7b398;border-bottom-width:4px;background:#fff8e8;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 13px}.header-button:hover{background:#e8e8c8;color:#3b5036}.header-button__count{background:#8ca373!important;color:#fff!important}.site-footer{border-top:2px solid #cfbca0;color:#82715e}.site-footer span{color:#82715e}.site-footer button{color:#786e63}.micro-label{letter-spacing:.16em;font:900 10px monospace;color:#9d7250}.breadcrumb{font-weight:900;color:#705e4d}.status-figures{color:#574c43}.status-figures small{color:#85745d}.button{border:2px solid #9d8566;border-bottom-width:5px;color:#4b4039;background:#fff8e9;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #b69f8033;min-height:49px}.button:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-2px);background:#fff3d0;border-color:#6e7957}.button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px);border-bottom-width:2px;box-shadow:none}.button--primary{color:#fffbee;background:#778f67;border-color:#566e55}.button--primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#617c55;color:#fff; border-color:#445c46}.button--subtle{background:#fff9ed;color:#574e43;border-color:#c7b49b}.word-score{color:#487b62}.panel{background:#fff7e9;border:2px solid #c1a988;border-bottom-width:5px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px #80684c12}.panel p,.rpg-page>p,.rpg-footnote{color:#786d5f!important}.panel h3,.rpg-page h1{color:#504238}.panel-top span{color:#6f8a61}.rpg-page{padding-top:28px}.rpg-mini-stats{border:2px solid #c3aa85;border-bottom-width:4px;background:#fff9e9;border-radius:8px}.rpg-mini-stats strong{color:#a37649}.rpg-mini-stats span{color:#816d57}.rpg-heading{margin-bottom:17px}.rpg-heading h1{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,41px);margin:4px 0 5px}.rpg-heading p{color:#8a745f;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}.rpg-heading h1:after{content:" ✿";font-size:.65em;color:#8fa273}.win-track i{background:#e5d5b8}.win-track .lit{background:#dfa952}.rpg-footnote{line-height:1.7}.quest-success,.star-earned{color:#64845e}.lab-result{background:#e2efd9;border-color:#93a780}.lab-result strong{color:#44673e}.full-select,.word-pair select,.hint-actions select,.search-input{background:#fffaf0;border:2px solid #c4b19a;color:#514438;border-radius:7px}.word-pair span,.select-label{color:#7c6b5a}.overlay-desc,.rules-prose{color:#776a5e}.modal{border:3px solid #b7a181;border-bottom-width:7px;background:#fff8e9;color:#493f36;border-radius:12px}.word-collection>span{background:#fff1d8;border:1px solid #d4b998;color:#5a483a}.hint-actions span{color:#776a5e}.log-list,.log-entry{color:#5b5048}.log-entry{border-color:#d6bea1;background:#fff6e8}.log-entry__words,.log-entry__index{color:#594e45}.log-entry__outcome--win{color:#54805b}.log-entry__outcome--draw{color:#ac833b}.log-entry__outcome--lose{color:#ae6565}.timer-inline{color:#6c5976}.timer-inline strong{color:#986285}
/* Title / main street */
.pixel-intro{padding:30px 0 45px}.pixel-intro__scene{position:relative;min-height:485px;overflow:hidden;border:5px solid #9f886c;border-bottom-width:9px;border-radius:12px;background:#bad0a5 url('data:image/png;base64,') center/cover;box-shadow:0 15px 0 #c4ae8e77,0 24px 55px #77614925;image-rendering:pixelated}.pixel-intro__scene:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff3d5df,#fdf0d5b5 50%,#e2e5bd40);pointer-events:none}.pixel-intro__sun{position:absolute;right:8%;top:8%;z-index:1;font-size:38px;color:#fff2c1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #fff)}.pixel-intro__banner{position:absolute;top:23px;left:28px;padding:7px 10px;color:#735641;background:#fff4d9;border:2px solid #b89b77;z-index:2;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}.pixel-intro__center{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:6%;top:28%;max-width:85%;text-align:left}.pixel-intro__tag{font:900 11px monospace;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#856d4d}.pixel-logo{font-size:clamp(46px,8vw,84px);letter-spacing:-.07em;line-height:1.3;color:#4b5f50;margin:5px 0 15px;text-shadow:4px 4px #fff5dc,6px 6px #d3bca0}.pixel-logo span{color:#9a654f}.pixel-logo small{display:block;font:900 clamp(15px,3vw,21px) monospace;letter-spacing:.31em;color:#765f4e;text-shadow:none}.pixel-intro__center>p{display:inline-block;background:#fff8e9e5;border-left:5px solid #9fb181;padding:10px 15px;font-size:15px;font-weight:900}.pixel-intro__foot{padding:27px 8px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:15px}.pixel-intro__foot>p{font-size:13px;line-height:2;color:#6f604f;margin:0}.pixel-intro__foot>span{font-size:11px;color:#907e69}.pixel-intro__foot>.button{min-width:min(350px,100%)}.story-page{padding:22px 27px;border:3px solid #cab18b;border-bottom-width:7px;border-radius:9px;background:#fff6e5;box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #b5a0882b}.story-page h1{color:#51453c}.story-page p{color:#6e6256}.story-page .story-strong{color:#66835b}
/* Town is a real, tappable 2D map. Each touch target has a floating sign. */
.town-map{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:960 / 664;max-height:670px;border:5px solid #ab9575;border-bottom-width:9px;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background:#a0c195;box-shadow:0 10px 0 #dac7a3,0 24px 42px #6a513f22}.town-map__ground{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;image-rendering:pixelated}.town-spot{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2px solid #816f5a;border-bottom-width:5px;border-radius:7px;background:#fff2d5f2;box-shadow:2px 3px 0 #5d524134;padding:7px 11px;min-width:100px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;color:#534539;z-index:2;transition:transform .14s,filter .14s}.town-spot:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-57%);filter:brightness(1.06)}.town-spot:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #355946;outline-offset:3px}.town-spot__name{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}.town-spot small{font-size:10px;color:#8e7657;white-space:nowrap}.town-spot--veg{border-color:#7f9c6c}.town-spot--fish{border-color:#6596a8}.town-spot--animal{min-width:86px;background:#ebf3d5e8;border-color:#8ba375}.town-spot--goods{border-color:#bb926f}.town-spot--print{border-color:#92909d}.town-spot--lab{min-width:75px;background:#e9e0edf1;border-color:#b7a0b9}.town-spot--lab.is-locked{background:#c6babeec;color:#5e5456}.town-spot--boss{min-width:127px;background:#554955;color:#fff0dc;border-color:#a58e8c;padding:6px 10px}.town-spot--boss .town-spot__name{font-size:12px}.town-map__park{position:absolute;left:50%;top:46%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);color:#4d6d4e;font-weight:900;font-size:11px;background:#fbf6d2d8;padding:5px 7px;border:1px solid #96b17d;border-radius:4px;pointer-events:none}.town-map__caption{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;padding:13px 8px;color:#82694d;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.pixel-world .rpg-footnote{text-align:center}
/* Merchant counter + expressive hand-crafted character sprites */
.pixel-shop-scene{position:relative;aspect-ratio:800 / 452;width:100%;max-height:450px;border:4px solid #ab8c6f;border-bottom-width:8px;border-radius:10px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;overflow:hidden;image-rendering:pixelated;box-shadow:0 8px 0 #d6c1a0}.pixel-shop-scene__sign{position:absolute;top:4%;left:5%;z-index:2;background:#fff2d7e8;border:3px solid #a48764;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:#614a36;image-rendering:auto}.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:12%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:clamp(108px,27%,178px);height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(7px 8px #50443344)}.pixel-character{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain}.shop-dialogue{position:relative;margin:-4px 15px 15px;background:#fff8e9;border:3px solid #a8896b;border-bottom-width:6px;border-radius:7px;padding:17px 22px;box-shadow:4px 5px 0 #d1b995}.shop-dialogue__name{position:absolute;left:13px;top:-16px;background:#6e8c67;color:#fff9e9;padding:5px 11px;border:2px solid #536a52;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border-radius:4px}.shop-dialogue p{margin:7px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;font-weight:700;color:#625346}.shop-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:15px}.shop-actions>.panel{margin:0}.shop-actions .panel .button{width:100%}.shop-actions .panel>p{min-height:36px}.pixel-lab-scene{position:relative;background-position:center;background-size:cover;border:3px solid #a898b1;border-bottom-width:7px;border-radius:9px;height:250px;image-rendering:pixelated;margin:12px 0 23px}.pixel-lab-scene>.pixel-character{position:absolute;width:115px;bottom:13%;left:calc(50% - 55px)}
/* Battle scene: character first, quiz second. Randomizer belongs to another visual world. */
.game-view,.pixel-battle{padding:26px 0 36px}.battle-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(285px,1fr) minmax(345px,1.08fr);gap:14px;min-height:540px}.pixel-battle .enemy-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;text-align:left;min-height:540px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid .enemy-panel h1{font-size:clamp(26px,3.8vw,36px);margin:4px 0 12px;color:#604d3f}.pixel-battle .enemy-panel__line{font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;color:#6a594d;text-align:left}.pixel-battle .challenge-panel__prompt{font-size:14px;color:#796858;margin:15px 0 0}.pixel-battle .challenge-panel__prompt span{color:#607c51}.pixel-battle .enemy-word{display:flex;min-height:123px;padding:13px 0 /* Consistent final boss & other states */
.boss-view{background:linear-gradient(#f9efda,#efe0d0);border:3px solid #85778b;border-bottom-width:7px;border-radius:9px;padding:28px 22px 42px;margin-top:18px}.boss-view__center{color:#544954}.boss-view__center>p{color:#7c6a77}.boss-view h1{color:#514353}.pixel-boss-portrait{width:170px;margin:0 auto -17px;position:relative;filter:drop-shadow(0 13px 10px #5c466b44)}.pixel-boss-portrait img{width:170px}.boss-view__orb{background:radial-gradient(#f3d8c4,#c9b2ba);border-color:#99849b;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px #9785a72d,0 0 45px #805c8f40;color:#654e68}.boss-view__orb span{color:#55435d}.boss-clock{border-color:#c7afb8;background:#f4e9e4}.boss-clock small{color:#857187}.boss-clock strong{color:#75526e}.boss-slot{background:#fff8ec;border:2px solid #b4a1ad;color:#554953}.kana-button{background:#fff5e5;color:#584d45;border:2px solid #bba48a}.kana-reference{background:#fff0d8;color:#594a3b;border-color:#c8ae8f}.kana-lit{background:#9aac78!important;color:#293a27!important;border-color:#6e8c59!important}.boss-submit{background:#67546c;border-color:#514253}.boss-submit:hover:not(:disabled){background:#55405c;border-color:#44324c}.outcome-view,.clear-view{background:#fff6e4;border:3px solid #b49b7b;border-bottom-width:7px;border-radius:9px;padding:29px 22px;margin:20px auto}.outcome-view h1,.clear-view h1{color:#5b4a3c}.outcome-view p,.clear-view p{color:#726454}.outcome-view__seal{color:#789567}.outcome-compare{background:#efe2cb;border-color:#c7b096}.outcome-compare strong{color:#4f493f}.share-preview{background:#f9ead0;border-color:#bca386;color:#5a4838}.clear-view__metrics{color:#57493e}.clear-view__metrics strong{color:#7e965f}.location-grid{display:none}.site-footer{padding-bottom:20px}

/* Dramatic interruption: the warm town palette is intentionally absent. */
.randa-encounter{position:relative;max-width:730px;margin:28px auto 44px;padding:24px;background:#30283c;color:#fce9eb;border:5px solid #9b6d94;border-bottom-width:10px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #b99db066,0 20px 65px #79627650;overflow:hidden;text-align:center}.randa-encounter:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0px,transparent 14px,#e66fa70c 15px,#e66fa70c 17px);z-index:1}.randa-encounter__eyebrow{font:900 13px monospace;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#ffa7c6;animation:glitch 2s infinite steps(2)}.randa-encounter__stage{position:relative;height:305px;margin:16px 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4d3757 0,#58405e 65%,#392b43 65%,#392b43 100%);border:3px solid #956f9b;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}.randa-encounter__stage:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:3px;height:5px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#ac7c9f 0 14px,transparent 14px 28px);opacity:.42}.randa-encounter__sprite{position:absolute;bottom:-48px;width:244px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);filter:drop-shadow(8px 4px #c261a269)}.randa-encounter__unknown{position:absolute;font:900 82px monospace;letter-spacing:.06em;top:21px;right:25px;color:#d58ca499;transform:rotate(-12deg)}.randa-encounter__dialogue{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:14px 13px 20px;background:#44334c;border:2px solid #ae85a6;border-bottom-width:5px;border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:19px}.randa-encounter__dialogue>span{font:900 11px monospace;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#d5a5c4}.randa-encounter__dialogue h1{margin:8px 0 14px;color:#fff0f8;font-size:clamp(29px,6vw,42px);text-shadow:3px 3px #a0568f}.randa-encounter__dialogue p{font-weight:800;line-height:2;color:#fae6ee;font-size:14px}.randa-encounter__dialogue small{display:block;color:#d5bdd3;font-size:12px}.randa-encounter>.button{width:min(430px,100%);margin:auto;background:#9c6f99;border-color:#cf95b7;color:#fff7ec}.randa-encounter>.button:hover{background:#b881a4;border-color:#f0c5df}
@media(max-width:700px){.randa-encounter{margin-top:15px;padding:13px;border-width:3px;border-bottom-width:8px}.randa-encounter__eyebrow{font-size:11px}.randa-encounter__stage{height:248px;margin:12px 0}.randa-encounter__sprite{width:207px;bottom:-47px}.randa-encounter__unknown{font-size:50px;top:10px;right:10px}.randa-encounter__dialogue{padding:10px}.randa-encounter__dialogue p{font-size:12px}}


/* V3: higher-resolution sprites, uneven neighborhood composition and readable retro lettering. */
:root{--font:'M PLUS Rounded 1c','Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN','Hiragino Sans','Yu Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;--display-font:'DotGothic16','M PLUS Rounded 1c','Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN',sans-serif}
body,.button,button,select{font-family:var(--font)}
.pixel-logo,.rpg-heading h1,.story-page h1,.pixel-shop-scene__sign,.shop-dialogue__name,.enemy-panel__identity h1,.boss-view h1,.clear-view h1,.randa-encounter__dialogue h1{font-family:var(--display-font);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.035em}
.micro-label,.brand__word,.pixel-intro__tag,.randa-encounter__eyebrow,.randa-encounter__dialogue>span,.outcome-view__top{font-family:var(--display-font);letter-spacing:.12em}
.story-page p,.pixel-intro__foot p,.shop-dialogue p,.enemy-panel__line{font-weight:500;line-height:1.94}
.town-map--lived{aspect-ratio:960/664;max-height:none;background:#a1bf94}
.town-map__art{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.town-map__ground{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:fill;image-rendering:pixelated}
.town-map--lived .town-spot{transform:translate(-50%,-50%);min-width:70px;min-height:40px;padding:4px 9px;gap:1px;border:2px solid #796b58;border-bottom-width:4px;border-radius:4px;background:#fff6dceF;box-shadow:2px 4px 0 #57463740}
.town-map--lived .town-spot:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-55%)}
.town-map--lived .town-spot__name{font:900 13px var(--display-font)}
.town-map--lived .town-spot small{font-size:9px}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--veg{left:16%;top:29%;border-color:#789568}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--fish{left:82%;top:29%;border-color:#7199a2}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--animal{left:85%;top:76%;border-color:#aa9770}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--goods{left:17%;top:83%;border-color:#b38765}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--print{left:51%;top:94%;border-color:#7a7f92}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--lab{left:53%;top:29%;border-color:#938a9c;min-width:60px}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--boss{left:87%;top:98%;border-color:#a58d98;background:#554858;color:#fff3e0;min-width:109px}
.town-map--lived .town-map__park{left:50%;top:55%;background:#fff8deeb;font:900 12px var(--display-font)}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(130px,28%,198px);bottom:12%}
.pixel-battle__portrait{width:clamp(145px,38%,210px);bottom:8%}
.pixel-character{image-rendering:pixelated;transform-origin:center bottom;animation:pixel-idle 6.4s steps(2,end) infinite}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper .pixel-character{animation-duration:7.1s}
.pixel-battle--randa .pixel-character,.randa-encounter__sprite .pixel-character{animation:unsettling-idle 7.3s steps(3,end) infinite}
.pixel-boss-portrait{width:210px;margin:0 auto -14px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #77618a40)}
.pixel-boss-portrait img{width:210px}
.pixel-boss-portrait .pixel-character{animation:boss-idle 9s ease-in-out infinite}
.boss-view{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%,#e6dae8 0,#f5eddd 46%,#e8d7c8);border-color:#85758c}
.boss-view__orb{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px #92819e1b,0 0 60px #76538262;background:radial-gradient(#f3e3d6,#cebfcf)}
.randa-encounter__sprite{width:250px;bottom:-51px}
@keyframes pixel-idle{0%,27%,64%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}35%,54%{transform:translateY(-2px)}}
@keyframes unsettling-idle{0%,28%,68%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}38%,54%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
@keyframes boss-idle{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(1deg)}}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .town-map--lived{aspect-ratio:480/690;min-height:0;max-height:none}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot{min-width:59px;max-width:95px;min-height:31px;padding:3px 4px;border-width:1px;border-bottom-width:3px}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot__name{font-size:11px}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot small{font-size:8px}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--veg{left:20%;top:23%}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--fish{left:80%;top:22%}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--animal{left:82%;top:66%}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--goods{left:22%;top:84%}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--print{left:78%;top:96%}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--lab{left:55%;top:27%;min-width:50px}
 .town-map--lived .town-spot--boss{left:51%;top:98%;min-width:95px}
 .town-map--lived .town-map__park{left:45%;top:48%;font-size:9px}
 .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(132px,37%,176px)}
 .pixel-battle__portrait{width:84%;bottom:0}
 .pixel-boss-portrait,.pixel-boss-portrait img{width:155px}
 .pixel-logo{font-size:clamp(35px,10vw,61px)}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.pixel-character,.pixel-boss-portrait .pixel-character{animation:none!important}}

/* v7 character refresh */
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(150px,31%,228px);bottom:6%}
.pixel-battle__portrait{width:clamp(170px,42%,245px);bottom:3%}
.pixel-lab-scene>.pixel-character{width:148px;bottom:6%;left:calc(50% - 74px)}
@media(max-width:700px){.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(128px,45%,188px);bottom:2%}.pixel-battle__portrait{width:88%;bottom:-1%}}

/* v8: rougher portrait language + less synchronized AI-like staging */
.pixel-character{image-rendering:pixelated;filter:none!important}
.pixel-battle__portrait,.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{filter:drop-shadow(4px 5px #3b302b33)}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper .pixel-character,.pixel-battle__portrait .pixel-character{animation-duration:9.5s}
.pixel-battle__portrait .pixel-character[src*="randa"],.randa-encounter__sprite .pixel-character{animation-duration:8.2s}
/* asymmetry between residents */
.pixel-shop-scene--veg .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-1.2deg)}
.pixel-shop-scene--fish .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(.8deg)}
.pixel-shop-scene--animal .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-.6deg)}
.pixel-shop-scene--goods .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(.5deg)}
.pixel-shop-scene--print .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-.4deg)}

/* v9 true low-resolution pixel art. Source sprites are hand-designed on a 64x96 grid. */
.pixel-character{image-rendering:pixelated!important;image-rendering:crisp-edges;filter:none!important}
.pixel-battle__portrait{width:clamp(150px,40%,228px);bottom:2%}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(145px,31%,210px);bottom:3%}
.pixel-lab-scene>.pixel-character{width:138px;bottom:4%;left:calc(50% - 69px)}
@media(max-width:700px){.pixel-battle__portrait{width:86%;bottom:-2%}.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(128px,44%,176px);bottom:0}}


/* V10: medium-density portrait direction.
   Character PNGs are rebuilt at a true 216x288 working grid and nearest-neighbor doubled. */
.pixel-character{
  image-rendering:pixelated;
  image-rendering:crisp-edges;
}
/* Store: let the silhouette and clothing read as a full person. */
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{
  width:clamp(150px,31%,220px);
  bottom:-2%;
}
/* Battle: deliberately crop the same sprite to roughly knee-up / bust-up.
   The overflow of .pixel-battle__room creates the portrait crop. */
.pixel-battle__portrait{
  width:clamp(285px,78%,410px);
  bottom:-48%;
  left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  filter:drop-shadow(4px 5px #251f2430);
}
.pixel-battle__room{
  min-height:330px;
  background-position:center;
}
.pixel-battle--randa .pixel-battle__portrait{
  width:clamp(300px,82%,430px);
  bottom:-47%;
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .pixel-battle .enemy-panel{
    grid-template-columns:48% 52%;
    grid-template-rows:minmax(225px,auto);
  }
  .pixel-battle__room{min-height:225px}
  .pixel-battle__portrait{
    width:142%;
    bottom:-55%;
  }
  .pixel-battle--randa .pixel-battle__portrait{
    width:150%;
    bottom:-54%;
  }
  .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{
    width:clamp(135px,44%,188px);
    bottom:-2%;
  }
}


/* v11 tuning: map spacing, battle framing, slower idle, richer rooms */
.town-map--lived .town-spot--veg{left:14%;top:27%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--fish{left:79%;top:24%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--animal{left:74%;top:71%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--goods{left:21%;top:79%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--print{left:58%;top:88%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--lab{left:46%;top:33%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--boss{left:87%;top:90%}
.town-map--lived .town-map__park{left:49%;top:58%}

.pixel-shop-scene{background-position:center bottom}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(150px,31%,224px);left:49%;bottom:5%}
.pixel-battle__room{min-height:300px;background-position:center bottom}
.pixel-battle__portrait{width:clamp(158px,33%,214px);bottom:-2%;left:50%}
.pixel-character{animation:pixel-idle 8.8s steps(2,end) infinite}
.pixel-shop-scene__keeper .pixel-character{animation-duration:9.4s}
.pixel-battle--randa .pixel-character,.randa-encounter__sprite .pixel-character{animation:unsettling-idle 10.2s steps(3,end) infinite}
@keyframes pixel-idle{0%,32%,70%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}42%,56%{transform:translateY(-1px)}}
@keyframes unsettling-idle{0%,32%,70%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}42%,56%{transform:translateY(-2px)}}

@media(max-width:700px){

 .pixel-shop-scene__keeper{width:clamp(128px,36%,172px);bottom:4%}
 .pixel-battle .enemy-panel{grid-template-columns:44% 1fr}
 .pixel-battle__room{min-height:190px}
 .pixel-battle__portrait{width:72%;bottom:-1%}
}

.town-map--lived .town-spot--veg{left:17%;top:34%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--fish{left:79%;top:31%}
.town-map--lived .town-spot--animal{left:80%;top:77%}
